meshy.note: Smart Topology generates directly at target_polycount (no remesh pass); base colour only, no PBR maps.

units: GLB own units (unitless, Meshy normalises the longest side to about 0.95; NOT metres). Origin is the bounding-box centre, not the ground: lift by -bbox_min[1] to stand it on y=0.
orientation: Lies along X: bayonet tip at -X, butt at +X, lock/hammer up (+Y). Thin in Z.

reference_image.prompt: Use the attached image only as the art-style reference (stylized 3D CGI, smooth slightly clay-like surfaces, bright saturated toy-like colours, chunky thick-edged shapes). Create a NEW reference image for 3D modelling of ONE single object: an oversized, chunky toy-like 1860s musket with a thick warm-brown wooden stock, a thick steel barrel, brass bands and trigger guard, and a fat steel bayonet fixed at the muzzle. It lies exactly horizontal in a pure side view (profile), muzzle pointing right, spanning most of the image width, perfectly straight. No hands, no soldier, no sling. Whole object in frame, centred, margin all around. Plain pure white background, flat even studio lighting, no ground, no cast shadow, no other objects, no text.
